people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: For the Lord Yahweh says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.
translations.bsb: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you!
translations.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come
translations.asv: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
